test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the full form of INSPIRE scheme, which one of the flagship programmes of the Department of Science & Technology (DST), Government of India?

options.text: Innovation in Science Pursuit for Indian Research
Innovation in Science Pursuit for Indigenous Research
Innovation in Science Pursuit for Interdisciplinary Research
Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research

solution:
The correct answer is __**Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The INSPIRES (Sikkim: Integrated Service Provision and Innovation for Reviving Economies) scheme focuses on training and upskilling women and youth in Sikkim.
 
• It aims to provide employment opportunities in high-growth sectors such as renewable energy, information and technology (IT) services, tourism, hospitality and wellness care, and creative design.
 
• The scheme includes establishing an Employment and Entrepreneurship Promotion Facility to foster partnerships with private-sector firms and provide staff training.
 
• It also involves organizing bootcamps, workplace safety management systems, and providing transport allowance and business development support to facilitate job transition for women and youth.
 
• The scheme addresses the aspirations of Sikkim's youth, who aim to work in non-farm sectors and require technical and foundational skills for employment.
